outcomes.statement: communicates ideas graphically using freehand sketching and accurate drafting techniques
analyses the context of information and intended audience to select and develop appropriate presentations
designs and produces a range of graphical presentations
evaluates the effectiveness of different modes of graphical communications for a variety of purposes
identifies, interprets, selects and applies graphics conventions, standards and procedures in graphical communications
manages the development of graphical presentations to meet project briefs and specifications
manipulates and produces images using digital drafting and presentation technologies
designs, produces and evaluates multimedia presentations
identifies, assesses and manages relevant WHS factors to minimise risks in the work environment
demonstrates responsible and safe work practices for self and others
demonstrates the application of graphics to a range of industrial, commercial and personal settings
evaluates the impact of graphics on society, industry and the environment

modules.title: Graphic Design & Communication
modules.assessment_boundary: Current 2026 schedule: Graphic Design and Communication, Term 1 Week 10, 35%; draft notification requires teacher approval.

sections.title: Safety signs and visual conventions
content_descriptors: Identify and apply standard symbols and related conventions in graphic-design and communication contexts.
Recognise the significance of standard symbols in international, multilingual and cultural communication.
Identify WHS issues related to graphics products and processes and demonstrate safe and responsible practices.
sections.learning_intention: Explain and apply safety signs and visual conventions in a source-controlled graphics context.
learning_sequence: Read the named theory with teacher explanation.
Notice three purposeful visuals and complete the answerable media pathway.
Apply the concept in the linked activity and supervised graphics task.
Check ten MCQs, complete the capstone and select folio evidence.
adjustments: Use the complete non-video pathway.
Provide sentence stems, chunked sequence and teacher-selected accessible source views.
Allow keyboard, touch, print and exported browser-local evidence paths.
literacy_numeracy_digital: Explain graphical decisions using evidence and precise vocabulary.
Interpret proportion, scale, alignment, spatial or dimensional relationships only from authorised sources.
Create, save, export and evaluate digital graphics while preserving provenance and privacy.
sections.safety_workplace: Follow current teacher instructions and authorised local procedures. The website supports graphical communication and does not replace induction, supervision, risk controls or licensed standards.
resources: teacher-approved master or drawing where applicable
sections.practical_application: Critique and refine a rights-safe sign communication using observed hierarchy, contrast, symbol and context evidence; follow current teacher instructions for any local safety content.
